Title: rico loco: how to prevent the damage

Messages.Author: gotcha
Messages.Body:
Sabbat. Black Hand: If Rico is ready during your master phase, move a Bomb from your hand or ash heap to him (no cost) or he takes 1 damage. During your untap phase, if Rico is ready and has a Bomb, burn the Bomb and another ready minion you control takes 2 damage.

I was wondering how to / any ideas on preventing the damage rico takes when not equipping a bomb during master phase ...

Messages.Author: a-e
Messages.Body:
Give Rico a Blood Doll, Vessel and Rack. During your untap take one blood of from Rico to your pool, then gain two blood from Rack. During master phase take one damage from Rico's special and then move one blood to Rico from your pool via Blood Doll. So now your pool total is still same as before and you have negated the damage as Rico's blood total is still same

Is it worth it? No.

Marko, Prince of Helsinki

There's currently no way to prevent that damage. You can make it gain blood though to offset the blood loss (with a Hunting Ground for instance).
